summary: This 6-K filed on June 2, 2026 announces the resignation of director Dr. Barbara Krebs-Pohl, effective May 31, 2026, with no disagreement cited and her agreement to serve as an independent consultant. No deal terms, price, or tender are involved; it is a routine board departure. The filing is a foreign private issuer report under Rule 13a-16. There is no acquisition, divestiture, strategic review, or other special-situation event. The resignation appears amicable and voluntary, not a forced change. What to watch: further board changes or consulting agreement details, but no risk-arb angle.
